song.title: I'm free, so Free, I in the Spirit, and the Spirit
song.lyrics:
[V1] .G Lord, I will praise you forever. . C For one precious moment. . G D7 When I felt sin's burdens on me . G And when my heart of joy is crying . C How can my debts be dying . G D7 G My heart testifies, I'm free
[C1] . D7 G I'm free. So Free. . D7 G I in the spirit and the spirit in me . C G C I'm rejoicing because I am not what I was . G D7 G Thanks to Calvary's tree, I'm free
[V2] .G And lord, I will praise you forever. . C For one precious moment . G D7 For if I felt sin's burdens on me . G Now my heart with joy is crying . C How can my debts be dying . G D7 G My heart testifies I'm free
